bonzo.name: Bonzo
bonzo.origin: Bonzo was a savage tribal leader that was alive circa 50,000 BC. His savage attack on innocents attracted the attention of prehistoric adventurers Tuk and Tanir. While Tuk came to the rescue of a woman named Eve and her baby, Tanir infiltrated Bonzo's tribe by offering to share the secret of his bow and arrow to the primitives. However, unconvinced of Tanir's loyalty, Bonzo ordered him to eliminate Tuk. However, Tanir created a stampede of elephants that Tuk used to scatter Bonzo's tribe. Without his minions to protect him, Bonzo was easily slain by an arrow to the neck fired by Tuk.
weapons: Bonzo used a club.

booie dawdly.name: Booie Dawdly
booie dawdly.origin: Booie Dawdly lived a double life, the unassuming pawn shop owner and good friend to local police officer O'Brien, he was also the up-and-coming crime boss known as the Imp. However, his dreams of being the over-lord of all crime came to a crashing end the night his operations crossed paths with the Witness. Sending two of his gang members to rob Cartiffy's Jewelry store (located across the street from his own pawn shop), the crooks tangled with the Witness. One of the crooks got away with the stolen loot, while the other one was captured by the Witness and forced to talk. The following morning, when officer O'Brien paid Booie a visit, he asked Booie to keep an eye out for the stolen jewels from the night before, little suspecting that the nondescript pawnshop owner was responsible for organizing the robbery. Having learned that the pawn shop had some connection to the Imp, the Witness entered shortly after the departure of office O'Brien and demanded to be brought to the Imp. Booie directed the hero to a trap door in the back of his shop and sent the hero down alone. Rushing around to another entrance, Booie and his remaining henchman ambushed the Witness, revealing his double identity to the hero. Despite being outnumbered two to one, the Witness beat both the Imp and his henchman in battle and left them and their stolen loot on the counter of the pawn shop for officer O'Brien to find when he returned to the shop. The subsequent fate of the Imp is unknown.
weapons: The Imp arms himself with a pistol.

Their horses were then used by the travelers who were allowed to come along with Hammad's party.

fields.notes: Borak is presumably a reference to El Borak (of his real name Francis X. Gordon), a modern-age American adventurer created by Robert E. Howard, as "The Abode of the Damned" ( ) is freely adapted from The Country of the Knife into a Conan story. Like other characters of REH, Borak was an idealized portrait of himself (a Texan of Gaelic lineage), and many of his stories parallel Conan's. The Conan the Barbarian story "The Flame Knife" (1955) was a novel revised by L. Sprague de Camp from Howard's original Francis X. Gordon story "Three-Bladed Doom" by Robert E. Howard. It was adapted in and (July and August, 1978). Marvel Comics reproduced this process, by freely adapting El Borak/Francis X. Gordon as Conan stories: "The Abode of the Damned" ( ; April, 1976) is adapted from " " ( ; August, 1936). "The Lost Valley of Iskander" ( to ; October to December, 1977) is adapted from the . (published posthumously in 1974). "Sons of the White Wolf" ( ; February, 1979) is adapted from the El Borak story " ( ; December, 1936). "The Daughter of Raktavashi" ( and ; June and July, 1995) is adapted from the El Borak story " " ( ; December, 1934).

bori.name: Bori
bori.origin: ===Origin=== Bori was a great chief at the time of the Cataclysm that led the tribe of the Hybori (or Hyborians) into the Far North, where they displaced the indigenous white apes from the region, and prospered. A legend, Bori was raised to the status of deity, worshiped by the Hybori after the Lesser Cataclysm. ===Hyborian Age=== He became the war-god of the Hyperboreans, who sacrificed to him the souls of those slain in battle. He was also worshiped by Vanirmen, and formerly by the Gundermen, who adopted Mitra in his place at the time they joined Aquilonia (that being their greatest concession). ====Age of Conan==== King Tomar of Hyperborea allegedly sent more warriors to Borri than man could count. Bori met with Conan in Brythunia, gazed upon the passing of the Choosers of the Slain and prophesized to Conan the reaping of kings. He later observed from the sky as Kings Tomar and Brian dueling and slaying each other simultaneously, then summoned rain and sent the Choosers of the Slain, for the last time, as even Gods must die when their worshippers are all dead. Afterwards, in the aftermath of the battle of Ravenfield , Borri turned his back upon mankind as few of his worshippers were left alive from the fighting. He then retreated into his frozen realm with the Choosers of the Slain, apart from Skalla who had tasted life in taking it, and wanted it for herself. As she met Conan, Hylda came to force Skalla to follow Borri's departure, because as she would have killed Conan and many others by draining their lives.
powers: Borri was seemingly able to summon rain.
weapons: Gleaming sword.

fields.notes: This character was created by Robert E. Howard in his essay "The Hyborian Age" (an unpublished fragment written in the 1930s). Roy Thomas and Barry Smith adapted Howard's non-Conan historical fiction tale "The Grey God Passes" in a Conan story by in "The Twilight of the Grim Grey God!" ( ; February, 1971), in which Odin was replaced by Bori. Though spelled "Borri" in Conan the Barbarian #3, Roy Thomas confirming the correct spelling was "Bori", fitting with Howard's character. Bori was named after the god Borr/Burr from Scandinavian mythology, the father of Odin and grandfather of Thor. Whether the Marvel Comics' version of Bori is related to the Asgardians has never been clarified. The has speculated that Bori is an alias used by either Bor Burison or Buri.

boris partner of ninotchka.name: Boris (Partner of Ninotchka)
boris partner of ninotchka.first_appearance: Power Man and Iron Fist Vol 1 77
boris partner of ninotchka.origin: ===Early Life=== Boris was a mercenary who teamed up with Ninotchka, a former K.G.B. trainee of the Red Room. Operating as "Boris and Ninotchka," they offered their services to anyone who could afford it. They were hired by the Russian government to make sure famous Russian ballerina Elyena Sorodin would not defect to the West. She was in love with an American dancer called Peter Penkowsky, so Boris and Ninotchka tried to put a stop to it. The duo's attack lead to a fight between the mercenaries and Power Man, Iron Fist, and Daredevil. ===Heroes for Hire=== Once again hired by the Russian government who had a vested interest in benefiting from the socio-political tensions between the neighboring countries of Halwan and Murtakesh, Boris and Ninotchka were sent to Halwan to prepare for the arrival of the Russian diplomat Stolveski. They soon befriended both the Halwan royal palace guard and princess Azir. Aware that Abe Brown, the former Black Tiger, had acquired the services of the Heroes for Hire, Ninotchka shadowed Luke Cage, Iron Fist, and their associate Jeryn Hogarth as they travelled to Halwan in order to exonerate Brown. She watched how Hogarth was taken into custody as soon as their plane landed in Halwan, before returning to Boris at the royal palace. boris grumm.name: Boris Grumm
boris grumm.origin: Boris Grumm was a television producer known for violent and controversial crime dramas, valuing high ratings over criticism from colleagues and audiences. While researching ideas for a new program in a public library, he discovered an old book recounting the life of the sorcerer Sazzik and decided to base a television series on the figure despite objections from his production staff regarding its disturbing content. While alone reviewing the book late at night, Grumm unknowingly recited an incantation that summoned Sazzik to Earth. Furious at being awakened from centuries of rest, the sorcerer cast a spell that exiled Grumm to a fog-filled otherworld before disappearing. After Grumm’s sudden disappearance, production of the planned series was canceled.

boris korpse.name: Boris Korpse
boris korpse.origin: Master scientist and demolitions expert Dr. Boris Korpse infiltrated a top-secret military base on the south shore of Long Island, masterfully slipping past the guards and security systems. Once inside, however, he was surprised to find that someone else had infiltrated the base: the Black Cat! The Cat then recruited Korpse to break Walter Hardy out of prison. Armed with guns stolen from black market arms dealer, Emil Greco, Korpse was lowered to Hardy's cell window by the Cat's other hireling, strongman Bruno Grainger; Korpse then blew the cell open with explosives. Korpse fled with Grainger, Walter Hardy, and the Cat; she promised to call them again if she needed them. As she departed with Hardy, Korpse tried to convince Grainger to work for him, but soon the Kingpin arrived and struck Grainger down, persuading both men to work for him. Boris joined the Black Cat in a heist of a painting from the Frick Collection. Acting as a server, Boris and Bruno Grainger ended up stealing one of the paintings while Felicia acted as the bait because of her history the security were focused more on her then anyone else. Boris held the car door open for Felecia after she was escorted off them premises. As Boris and the others made their getaway, they were attacked by the Thieves Guild who wanted to steal the painting for themselves. They managed to escape due to the untimely appearance of security guard Sonny Ocampo. Back at the hideout, Boris was pouring himself a drink when they were surprised when the buyer of the painting showed up at their place revealing himself as the Black Fox.
abilities: Dr. Boris Korpse is a highly skilled infiltrator and demolition expert. He carries a variety of explosives, including gas bombs.

He rose through the ranks quickly, becoming one of Pushkin's two main operatives, alongside his partner, Sickle, becoming one of Pushkin's Byki (personal bodyguards). Hammer was dispatched to assassinate Major Barrington who was being held by Department H before giving testimony at an inquest. The mercenary known as Maverick, brainwashed into Pushkin's service, was sent in as a distraction. He broke through the defences and attacked Barrington. While the attention was focussed on Barrington, Sickle attacked Department H's Director of Foreign Affairs, Pierre Cloche. While the attention was then focussed on Cloche, Hammer moved in, fought and disabled Puck.

boris meacham.name: Boris Meacham
boris meacham.origin: ===Legion of Vengeance=== Boris Meachum was once a normal optician. To stay ahead of the competition, he spent many hours making experimental glasses. One night while making lenses from an experimental material which he'd discovered at a dig near a test sight, he tried on the glasses, discovering that they allowed him to see a person's "true, corrupt nature" when looked through. Seeking to rid the world of hypocrisy, he used this material to create a mask and suit, becoming a "hero" known as the Mind's Eye, the Omniscient. As the Mind's Eye he joined the new hero group the Legion of Vengeance-- the world's deadliest heroes. The Legion of Vengeance were first discovered by the Ghost Rider when he witnessed Mind's Eye throw a man, who he perceived to be a racist and hypocrite, onto train tracks with the intent to kill him. Ghost Rider rescued the man but the Mind's Eye fled, while the rest of the Legion of Vengeance enacted their judgements elsewhere. The Mind's Eye next appeared at Cypress Hills Cemetery where he witnessed a couple kissing, perceiving them to be deceitful and treacherous. He directed Bacillus, another member of the Legion of Vengeance, to inflict them with disease. Bacillus successfully infected the man but was interrupted by the Ghost Rider and Iron Fist, resulting in Iron Fist being infected during a fight and giving the Mind's Eye and Bacillus an opportunity to escape. The Legion of Vengeance regrouped at their hidden base beneath a mausoleum in Cypress Hills Cemetery, but were followed by the Ghost Rider and Iron Fist. During this fight the Ghost Rider was able to use his penance stare on each member of the Legion of Vengeance, revealing their origins-- and revealing a strange presence lurking on the edges of their lives. The demon D'Kay appeared, revealing to the Ghost Rider and Iron Fist that the Legion of Vengeance was its creation. It offered the two heroes the opportunity to see a future influenced by D'Kay, on the condition that they accompanied him into the Pit. Inside the Pit D'Kay revealed that sin made the members of the Legion of Vengeance susceptible to control, and that it manipulated the members' senses of justice, rationales, and outrage to its will, taking over their subconscious minds, tricking them into believing they were heroes, and planting rationalizations that led them to believe that they only they were right and righteous. Their powers made them harbingers of doom. D'Kay turned the Mind's Eye into its herald of betrayal and corruption of everything human. He was D'Kay's first herald of humanity's doom; the betrayal of the mind. After revealing his plot, D'Kay cast Ghost Rider and Iron Fist out of the Pit, where they continued their fight with the Legion of Vengeance. Ghost Rider inflicted each member of the Legion with Bacillus' disease, causing them to fall under a fever in which they were susceptible to suggestion. The heroes convinced each member that they were under the control of a demon and that their paths were not righteous. The spell broken, D'Kay had no choice but to remove each member's powers-- returning them to their normal, mediocre lives, but with the promise that they would return.

boris monguski.name: Boris Monguski
boris monguski.origin: Boris Monguski was a Russian officer assigned to capture the Hulk and bring him back to Russia to learn the secret behind his awesome power. In order to lure the Hulk into a trap, Monguski created a robotic body armor in the semblance of a barbaric, alien warrior which he named Mongu. As Mongu, Boris used a MIG disguised as a spaceship and landed in the United States several miles away from the Desert Base. He issued a challenge to battle Earth's mightiest mortal in combat. If his opponent should win, then Mongu would leave Earth forever. But if Mongu should prove victorious, then he would summon an alien fleet to conquer the Earth. He publicly announced that any who was brave enough to face him should meet him in the Grand Canyon at Sunset. Doctor Bruce Banner, who at this time had learned to maintain his intellect while in the form of the Hulk, accepted Mongu's challenge. Accompanied by Rick Jones, the Hulk traveled to the Grand Canyon to face Mongu. It only took him seconds to see through Monguski's ruse, at which point, Boris ordered his soldiers to bring the Hulk down. They momentarily distracted him with sonic weapons, but one leap from the mighty Hulk caused a ground-quake, forcing all of the soldiers to fall to the ground. Monguski and his followers were bound together with their own uniform belts and fastened to a tow cable on a Soviet helicopter. Years later, Monguski returned, having been part of a group of 1960s-era Soviet agents who had been put into cryogenic sleep in order to be woken up in the event of a nuclear attack on American soil. After an explosion set off by the Infernal Man off the California coast woke them up, Monguski and his fellow Super-Soldiers fought, and were defeated by, the Order.
powers: By himself, Boris Monguski possessed no remarkable abilities. It is possible that the Mongu battle-suit allowed him greater strength and durability, but the Hulk tore through the suit before its full capabilities could be properly tested.

boris petrovsky.name: Boris Petrovsky
boris petrovsky.origin: Accused of pro-democracy leanings, Boris Petrovsky was commissioned to build a statue in honor of the communist government he opposed, thereby redeeming himself. Shipped off to a secluded air hanger, Petrovsky spent months carving out the perfect statue. The night his statue was ready, Petrovsky heard a loud noise come from outside the hanger. Going out to investigate, he found a crashed flying saucer, and a large alien. The alien telepathically communicated with Petrovsky, telling him that it needed to protect itself until more of its species arrived to take it back home. The alien inhabited the statue, and started moving around with the huge body. At the same time, Petrovsky's brother Ivan, a government official, showed up with his officers to inspect Boris' finished statue. Seeing the statue lumbering about, Ivan accused Boris of implanting a mechanical device in the statue, in order to use it for traitorous purposes. When the statue could not be subdued with normal weapons or artillery, a plane carrying a hydrogen bomb was called in to stop the statue. Ivan tied Boris to a chair, and left him in the strike zone, hoping to take care of two problems with the hydrogen bomb. The alien inside the statue noticed Boris tied to the chair, and took pity on him. Using the statue's massive body, the alien destroyed the strike planes and saved Boris. Shortly after, the alien's rescue ship arrived, and it departed the statue, and Earth's atmosphere. When Ivan returned to find the statue dormant and Boris alive, he was enraged, and demanded to know the secrets of the statue. Sensing an opportunity to champion democracy, Boris told Ivan that the statue was possessed by a high power that was not pleased with the ruthless communism of the country, and that the statue would attack once again if the government did not change their ways. Fearful of another attack, the government softened its grip, and Boris was pardoned.
abilities: Highly talented

borjigin byambyn khenbish.origin: The Demon was a Witch Doctor in an Asian jungle that was being hunted by Communists, when he came across a Norn Stone, which granted him tremendous strength. He began a path of conquest and gathered a number of followers as he subjected nearby villages. Eventually, Thor learned of the Demon's rampage and went to Asia to confront him. The Demon lacked the power to defeat Thor. The Demon ordered his followers to fire a cannon at Thor, but Thor plugged the cannon up with Mjolnir, causing it to explode and knock everyone out except Thor. Thor then confiscated the Norn Stone, removing the Demon's powers and ending his rampage.
powers: The Norn Stone the Demon found gave him and durability.
weaknesses: The Demon is entirely dependent on the Norn Stone for his powers.

borkor.name: Borkor
borkor.origin: thumb|left|124px|Original form Felix was a born in Geneva, Switzerland in early 1949. After his birth, he was kidnapped by Professor Grimm, a mad scientist who sought to test out a growth formula on a human subject in order to make him a massive giant which he would use for his own personal gain. Naming the baby Borkor and taking him to his hidden lab, he began his experiments on Felix, growing him to massive size. Making the boy obedient only to him, Professor Grimm then sent the baby on a rampage through the Swiss Alps. There they attacked a chalet to steal the safe. It just so happened that the Human Torch and Sun Girl were vacationing there at the time. Attacking Borkor, the Torch was captured and Professor Grimm succeeded in stealing the safe, however, he was unaware that Sun Girl had followed them. Back at his lab, Professor Grimm then buried the Human Torch in the snow and then put Borkor down to sleep before taking his stolen loot down to the village to buy more chemicals for his experiments. Sun Girl arrived shortly thereafter and rescued the Torch. The two then looked through Grimm's notes and learned the truth about Borkor and how to create an antidote. With the antidote in hand, they injected it into Borkor. Borkor woke up in a rage and began a rampage again with the Torch and Sun Girl following after him. Seeing his creation on the loose, Professor Grimm tried to stop him but was crushed under a fallen tree knocked down by Borkor. Soon after the antidote took effect and Borkor was reduced back to his original size. Learning Felix's real name and contacting his parents, the Torch and Sun Girl turned the boy over to his family and they were happily reunited. Felix's subsequent fate is unknown.
weaknesses: As Borkor, Felix appeared to be obedient to Professor Grimm only, likely another product of the formula he was exposed to.

bornag royale.name: Bornag Royale
bornag royale.origin: Count Bornag Royale was an agent of A.I.M., whose mission was to discredit Colonel Nick Fury with his superiors, in order to weaken SHIELD against AIM's attacks. To do so, Royale made use of A.I.M's reputation as a group of genius minds (at that point A.I.M. was not known as a criminal group), insisting that Fury was not the right man to lead SHIELD and pressuring the authorities to put Fury to formal investigation - always being careful to not call him a traitor. Fury suspected foul play, particularly as his other investigations also hinted that A.I.M. was breaking the law, so he agreed to go to the trial on the Helicarrier - but not before staging his own exit and ensuring the help of young, eager SHIELD agent Jasper Sitwell. While Royale expected Sitwell to testify against Fury, Sitwell was instead loyal to Fury. In any case, Fury escaped the trial to get proofs against Royale, and Sitwell discreetly put a tracker on him. Once Royale left the Helicarrier, Sitwell tracked him to a secret hideout - which suddenly exploded: Royale had either blow away the area to destroy proofs, or been noisily killed by fellow A.I.M. agents who found he had been compromised.
abilities: A great manipulator of emotions, intelligence and patriotism.

boromir.name: Boromir
boromir.species: Winged Horse created by the Beyonder
boromir.origin: Boromir was a winged horse created by the Beyonder when he had visited the home of Stewart Cadwall. The Beyonder was looking to learn and understand the ways of the world and Stewart abused his naïveté and asked him to provide him with power and became Thundersword. He did so and Boromir was created for him to use as a flying steed. Boromir disappeared when Thundersword was disarmed by Captain America and Iron Man and reverted back to his powerless human form.

borss.name: Borss
borss.origin: Borss was a lesser demon and broker of souls, working with his brother Mog'rys to trade and profit off the dead in the collective aftermath of every culture's shared Hell. In a bold plan, Borss and Mog'rys borrowed two billion human souls from Mephisto, which they sold to the Spirit-Flayers of Carcosa for vast riches. Using these riches, the brothers funded the empowerment and revival of Nebulon, whom they guided in pursuit of the Conductor and his cosmic, planet-consuming Train. With the Train under their control, the brothers and Nebulon would see the Earth destroyed, flooding the market of Hell with deposed human souls, vastly devaluing them, allowing them to buy the souls up in massive numbers, paying off their debt to Mephisto with minimal impact on their new profits. Nebulon systematically killed all of the Conductor's familiars, preventing the Train from changing course, and was able to overpower and take control of the Conductor itself. While the brothers watched as Silver Surfer and Namor confronted Nebulon, Mog'rys was confident in the face of Borss' fears that the heroes may succeed, reminding his brother that with the familiars dead, and the course locked, all the heroes could do to stop the Train would be to destroy it, which would release a storm of radiation so plentiful that it would still wipe out all life on countless worlds, the Earth included. Mog'rys was shocked, however, by the appearance of the Hulk, guided by the time-travelling astral ghost of Doctor Strange from a ruined future where that exact course of events had played out. Hulk easily overpowered Mog'rys, and bit his head off, decapitating the demon, but as he turned his rage on Borss, both demons transformed into their essence, abandoning their physical forms and imbuing themselves into Nebulon to give him an additional power boost. Strange then teleported with the Hulk to the Train, and had him distract Nebulon while he used his astral form to slip into the Conductor's macro-mind. Strange exerted all his will on the giant to induce a spasm which caused the Train to shift a fraction of a degree. At the speed and distances involved, this was enough to set the Train off course and miss the Earth. Since this caused Borss and Mog'rys' plan to pay Mephisto back to fall through, the Hell lord appeared and claimed their souls along with that of Nebulon.

bosede.name: Bosede
bosede.origin: Bosede was telepath from the Wakandan Jabari Tribe. After being visited by a Shi'ar patrol, he got romantically involved with their Commander and the two had a daughter. When the Shi'Ar returned home and left his daughter behind, Bosede decided to go look for the mysteries of Sin-Cong, promising his daughter to return. Unfortunately, Bosede somehow found himself trapped in the "World Behind the Doors", where he spent the rest of his days. As the years passed, his daughter grew into a young woman and decided to embark on a journey, looking for him. Accompanied by other heroes, she eventually found herself in the "World Behind the Doors" as well, where she finally got some closure as she discovered her father's corpse, still holding a Shi'ar gun (her mother's parting gift).
abilities: Bosede spoke and Nithoc.

boss district attorney.name: Boss (District Attorney)
boss district attorney.origin: The mob leader known merely as "The Boss" was really the District Attorney of a New England town in 1945. When his daughter's boyfriend Jim learned his secret identity, the Boss sent men to eliminate him. Jim was saved by Captain America and Bucky who brought the injured Jim to the hospital. There the Boss, in his role as District Attorney, learned that Jim would be in a coma for at least 12 hours and ordered an increase in security. However, the Boss made sure that the back of the hospital was not guarded and sent assassins to kill Jim before he could wake up and expose his double identity. Realizing this, Captain America and Bucky hid in the room and defeated Jim's would be killers and then gave the signal to the Boss that the job was done. When the D.A. entered the room, he exposed himself and was easily defeated by Cap and Bucky. His subsequent fate is unknown.
weapons: The Boss was armed with a pistol.

boss oasis spring water.name: Boss (Oasis Spring Water)
boss oasis spring water.origin: The boss of Oasis Spring Water oversaw the apprehension at the hands of Hydro-Man of heroes Hawkeye and Red Wolf, who were investigating the water contamination of Sweet Medicine Indian Reservation's only known spring, that was secretly part of a ruse created by Oasis to divert attention from the illegal water pumping station they had established in a second secret new-found water reservoir in the tribal land. The heroes were taken to the pumping station and the boss tried to interrogate them, but they managed to untie themselves. Red Wolf took down most of Oasis' armed militia while Hawkeye confronted Hydro-Man. The heroes were assisted by two of the reservation's inhabitants, Silas and Frank Fireheart, who had followed the militia to the station after having caught notice of the confrontation that preceded the heroes' capture. The boss' men were subsequently defeated, and the authorities dealt with Oasis Spring Water.

boss yakuza.name: Boss (Yakuza)
boss yakuza.origin: During his early mercenary assignments Deadpool traveled throughout Asia, and was hired in Japan by a crimelord, the Boss, to infiltrate a sumo-wrestling ring owned by a rival criminal, the Oyakata. Wilson spent three years as a wrestler under the Oyakata's tutelage and became romantically involved with his mentor's daughter, Sazae. When the Boss finally ordered the Oyakata's murder, Wilson refused to complete his assignment, allegedly the first time he had ever done so, and relocated to the United States.

boss barker.name: Boss Barker
boss barker.origin: Boss Barker was one of the Skrulls who lived on Kral IV, a colony whose population had chosen to pattern their culture after that of Earth in the 1930s. Barker led one of the prominent gangs and regularly bought slaves to fight as gladiators for him in the Great Games, battles to the death that would decide who controlled the various territories. Foremost among his rival gangs was that led by Lippy Louie. Eventually, Barker and Louie began a gang war over who would control both of their territories. Since the gang war would be decided by the Great Games and Louie's fighter was Torgo from Maarin, who had never been defeated, Barker was willing to pay the Slave-Master the exceptionally high price of ten perfect Power Stones in order to acquire Ben Grimm (a.k.a. The Thing) from Earth to be his fighting slave. Once Grimm had been captured and brought to Kral, Barker came to the spaceport to confirm his arrival but only paid the dealer one Power Stone at that time, stating that the dealer would get the rest once his slave had been trained and was in the arena. Once it had been announced that the Great Games were starting, Barker and two associates left his headquarters just seconds before it was destroyed by an explosion. Barker took the fact that Lourie had booby-trapped the room as proof that he was scared and feared that Torgo might not be able to defeat the Thing. Barker was then driven to the movie palace where he encountered Louie. The two of them then joined the other top territorial leaders of the area to watch the slaves fight to the death in the Games. Barker and Louie were in the stands watching as Torgo and the Thing began their battle. Torgo hurled a spherical weapon at the Thing who, unaware that it was a bomb, crushed it in his hand, setting it off. As Torgo moved in for the kill, Barker protested that it wasn't fair because the Thing wasn't being beaten by Torgo since he had exploded the bomb himself. While the audience discussed the matter, the Thing managed to deliver powerful punch that knocked Torgo away from him, and Louie called that a foul because the Thing had struck while they had been debating the rules. A rule decision declared that that battle was voided and that the combatants would stand by to continue with new weapons. During this second battle, there was a moment when the Thing could have killed Torgo but chose not to do so. As a result, Torgo soon managed to turn the tables on his foe, causing Barker to again protest that it was not fair and that it didn't count because the Earthling had had no knowledge of the Skrull weapon. However, Torgo then refused to murder someone who had shown him mercy. Angered by this defiance, the Skrulls prepared to destroy both of their home planets but were prevented from doing so by the arrival of Crystal, one of three of the Thing's Fantastic Four teammates who had come to Kral IV to rescue their kidnapped friend, who hurled shock waves that destroyed the Sonic Disruptor, the weapon that the Skrulls had threatened to use to destroy the home planets of any slaves who refused to obey them. With their home planets now safe, Torgo freed the other enslaved gladiators and led a rebellion against their Skrull masters. Boss Barker was believed to have been killed by Torgo during the revolt but he actually survived by using his shape-changing powers to imitate a corpse. Barker swore to pay both Torgo and the Thing back for wrecking his set-up. A few years later, Barker put his revenge plot in motion, first by capturing Torgo and cutting off his head. Barker then traveled to New York City where he began attacking the Thing, first by making a threatening phone call to the Thing while he was out having dinner with Alicia Masters, and then with a drive-by shooting outside the restaurant. The Thing wasn't actually hurt by the gunfire but his pursuit of the sedan led to him getting dumped in the river and nearly drowning. However, Grimm's friend, the Kree Captain Marvel, pulled him to safety and offered his aid. After the Thing and Mar-Vell relocated to an abandoned tenement, Barker waited until Mar-Vell was alone and then, disguised as the Thing, confronted the Kree. Although Mar-Vell's cosmic awareness let him know that this Thing was an imposter, Barker was able to subdue him. Then, as Barker, he confronted the Thing in the street. After revealing how he had survived and tossing Torgo's head to the Thing, Barker had his sedan's headlights fire brain-blast rays that knocked the Thing out. When Grimm regained consciousness, he was elsewhere, chained to a wall and about to be executed by five "Bowery Boys" androids armed with Skrull weapons. Captain Marvel arrived before the execution could be carried out and he dealt with some of the androids until the Thing freed himself and finished the last of them. Facing his two foes, Barker used a remote control to cause his starship to phase out of sub-space between them. With all of the starship's weaponry locked in on
weapons: Skrull-Military Weaponry: will frequently use the ranged energy-weaponry of the Skrull-military.

fields.unusual_features: In his natural Skrullian form he possessed pointed ears and a corrugated chin.

boss bragg.name: Boss Bragg
boss bragg.origin: Boss Bragg was the owner of a zooseum where people could see strange creatures from all over the universe. One of those creatures happened to be the human Marlo Chandler, wife of Rick Jones and ally of the super hero Captain Marvel. When Captain Marvel came to rescue Marlo, he freed every creature of the zooseum, severely irritating Bragg, who promised to get his revenge. And so he did: years later, while Genis was recovering from a telepathic procedure, Bragg took him and had his thugs beat him to death. However, Captain Marvel unleashed his full powers and turned everything around them in to rubble. Amidst the chaos, the skrull Jazinda, disguised as Thanos, appeared to demand that Captain Marvel be given to her. Scared to death, Boss Bragg complied and, as they left, he sighed in relief.

One of those creatures happened to be the human Marlo Chandler, wife of Rick Jones and ally of the super hero Captain Marvel. When Captain Marvel came to rescue Marlo, he freed every creature of the zooseum, severely irritating Bragg, who promised to get his revenge. And so he did: years later, while Genis was recovering from a telepathic procedure, Bragg took him and had his thugs beat him to death. However, Captain Marvel unleashed his full powers and turned everything around them in to rubble. Amidst the chaos, the skrull Jazinda, disguised as Thanos, appeared to demand that Captain Marvel be given to her. Scared to death, Boss Bragg complied and, as they left, he sighed in relief.

bottle imp.name: Bottle Imp
bottle imp.origin: The Bottle Imp was a demon who either was a bottle, or had been transformed into one by a higher demon. For thousands of years he trapped people inside himself and an illusionary form tortured them. While on a beach, he captured two girls which was witnessed by Doctor Strange who followed the girls inside the bottle. The demon claimed that he had supposedly been imprisoned in the bottle by another, more powerful demon but that he now liked to use the bottle to trap and torment humans. Doctor Strange and the demon traded spells back and forth and Doctor Strange found he could apparently neither harm the demon nor break himself out of the bottle. Strange eventually realized his spell for harming demons actually damaged the glass bottle and eventually the spell destroyed both the bottle and the demon with it, because the bottle was the demon itself.

boulder kinsmen.name: Boulder (Kinsmen)
boulder kinsmen.origin: Boulder is a member of the team of super-heroes sponsored by the Irish government called the Kinsmen. They were considered Ireland's answer to the Avengers. At some point in the past Boulder saved the life of a leprechaun named Wee One who gave him his enchanted boulder to use as a weapon. The Kinsmen were sent to Cassidy Keep to collect Sean Cassidy in the early morning hours for a long overdue debriefing by officials of the Irish government. However, the team discovered that he was not home, but they were greeted by his daughter, Theresa, and the Seneschal, Eamon O'Donnell. The team were brusk in their conversations with Theresa, demanding to know where her father was to the point a fight broke out between her and the Kinsmen. Teleplex, who had remained in the helicopter with their government liaison, Mr. McFadden, monitored their situation inside Cassidy Keep. At some point Teleplex's remote viewing of the situation was interrupted until Highlander came flying through the air out of Cassidy Keep. Moments later the rest of the team also left the building as they were unable to defeat the young mutant. Soon the angry Irishwoman took the defeated team to Mr. McFadden and Teleplex, telling them to leave her and her father alone and call first before they ever return to Cassidy Keep. Then she destroyed their expensive high-tech helicopter and left them to find their own way home.
weapons: Enchanted magical boulder

boundless.name: Boundless
boundless.origin: Four years after the Archetypes of J.U.S.T.I.C.E. fell during the invasion of Earth by the Kree and Skrulls, Boundless and five other outcast heroes came together to form the Great Society. They were able to repel the aliens and reclaim the Earth, and would serve as its greatest protectors. After facing and defeating an incursion by the Mapmakers, the Great Society faced yet another one immediately after, this time facing the Illuminati. The Great Society no longer had any means to stop this incursion the same way they had done before. And the Illuminati, who had informed them of their last resort being an antimatter bomb to destroy the other Earth, tried to convince them to work together in finding a way out of the situation before passing to the worst-case scenarios. However, Namor attacked Rider, and prompted a fight between the two groups of heroes for the survival of their own Earth. Even though the Great Society quickly took the upper hand, with Boundless in particular defeating Iron Man, Doctor Strange unleashed a demon which killed most of the Great Society, including Boundless. The Illuminati later destroyed the Great Society's Earth to save theirs.

bounty humanoid.origin: ===Early years=== Bounty is a renowned interdimensional bounty hunter. She claimed to never fail to track her targets, to have been romanced by pirates, gladiators, and emperors, and to have killed a personification of Death. ===Earth=== On several occasions Bounty had run-ins with superheroes, including the Fantastic Four and Spider-Man. While being known as a great fighter with something of a temper, she also shows her feminine side when dealing with people she feels she can open up to or to get what she wants from them. ===After Civil War=== After the Civil War, she was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative.

bourtai.name: Bourtai
bourtai.origin: Bourtai was a beggar in Wan Tengri who found Conan after he emerged from Tsien Hui's pool. He led him underground into the hideout of the local thieves' guild, where he explained him how the seven wizards came to Wan Tengri, overthrew the previous king and now ruled the city with magic and terror. Since the Cimmerian wished to save Kassar the sheep-herd from the wizards' fury, he then escorted Conan into the underground passages of the Flame Tower, but the two were soon separated. When Conan managed to escape from the arena of the seven wizards, Bourtai helped him crawl through the underground catacombs and reach the top of the Flame Tower to free the Princess. When she was restored as the legitimate ruler of Wan Tengri, he sailed away with the Cimmerian to accompany him in his adventures. Venturing through the desert southeast of the Vilayet Sea, they both attempted to rescue a man assaulted by bandits, but he eventually died, just before telling them about the Azure Eye of Kara-Shehr, a great jewel from the city of Kara-Shehr. A sandstorm consumed them, and when it dispersed, they found the lost city and began searching through the ruins. They eventually found it in the castle's throne room, clutched by a skeleton hand. Bourtai took the great blue gem, but Conan made him put it back, and the skeletal hand closed on the gem again. After being attacked by Kai Shahh and his bandits, Bourtai grabbed the jewel again and the mysterious guardian creature turned on him, leaving only a skeleton beside the one holding the gem.

bowser.name: Bowser
bowser.origin: Mr. Bowser was a senior official within the National Security Council, and one of Dr. Valerie Cooper's superiors. He ordered her to take on Sabretooth as part of the X-Factor team, and was in charge of the government's Hound program. His heavy handed attempts to control X-Factor and use them as an anti-mutant paramilitary would lead to Forge and X-Factor cutting ties with the government and faking their deaths to escape his control. When X-Force confronted him over the disappearance of mutant teenager Trevor Chase, they found him imprisoned within Bowser's house. Bowser was abducted by monsters created by Trevor's reality warping powers and disappeared. He would survive, however, reemerging soon after as one of the government officials overseeing Operation Zero Tolerance.

box of doom.name: Box of Doom
box of doom.origin: thumb|left|188px|The creature inside the box.The origins of the so-called Box of Doom are unknown. It houses a creature of great mystical power. Apparently the creature was trapped inside but could still project it's influence out to those near it in order to influence them into opening the box and setting it free. The creature inside would tempt people to do so by offering them great powers. In 1952, an unknown individual sent the Box of Doom to the Olympian love goddess Venus while she was working late at Beauty Magazine. When the package was delivered the creature inside the box made it's presence known, tempting both Venus and the delivery man Gordon Kostner to open the box. While Venus was able to resist the temptations, the delivery man could not and quickly opened it. Freed from it's prison the creature then merged it's spirit with that of the delivery man, transforming him into a Vampire. The newly empowered delivery man then attempted to attack Venus. However the goddess fled into a nearby subway station and upon noticing that the man did not cast a reflection she realized what he was. With a piece of splintered wood she found in a trash can, Venus then impaled the vampire creature through the heart seemingly killing it and the creature from within the box.

boyd wilson.origin: Dr. Boyd Wilson, a zoologist, specialized in the relationship between predator and prey. He believed mutants would soon replace humans as the dominant species on earth. He was part of an environmental survey that was struck down by the birth of the magickal FireFountain. Wilson was transformed into Beastmaster, with the ability to control animals. When the X-Men and Alpha Flight came to the city of those transformed, Beastmaster offered his services to find the missing Snowbird. However, he used his powers to turn Wolverine away from the hunt and return him to the citadel. When Wolverine revived, made sane by the powers of Anodyne, he began his hunt. He found Snowbird and defended her from Beastmaster and Pathfinder. In the ensuing battle, Pathfinder was killed and Beastmaster severely injured. Beastmaster would later give up his powers and regain his humanity.
powers: Animal Control: As Beastmaster, Wilson had the ability to control animals.

fields.unusual_features: As Beastmaster, Wilson was larger than average humans.

brace masked raider.name: Brace (Masked Raider)
brace masked raider.origin: Brace was a henchman of corrupt land rustler Jed Sirrah. When Jed was trying to convince Jeb and Dan Barnes to sell him their land before they discovered the large gold and oil deposits it contained, Brace decided to try and frame the brothers for a crime so the town's sheriff would run them out, allowing Jed to take over their land. Brace convinces the sheriff, himself an old partner of Sirrah who went straight, to stay out of the matter. Brace and Sirrah's other henchmen began dynamiting some rocks in the path of the stream that watered the Barnes brothers' property, drawing the attention of the Masked Raider. The Masked Raider scared off Sirrah's men before they had the chance to get the Barnes' to sign over their land. He followed the crooks back to town where a gunfight ensued, but Sirrah's men, Brace included, were no match for the Masked Raider.

bracken.name: Bracken
bracken.origin: Bracken was one of the many mutants living in Arakko after relocating to Amenth. At some point, War and Bracken fell in love, married, and had a son, Summoner. However, despite being part of the family, Bracken's mother-in-law Genesis didn't really care about him at all. While married to War, Bracken engaged in a romantic tryst with Solem. Bracken eventually broke the relationship off, with Solem later stating that he had been afraid of risking his status as prince consort over a dalliance with the delinquent Solem. When Bracken insulted Solem in his hearing, while coming across him with his wife, Solem took the insult as a challenge. He used Blightswill to disable Bracken's powers, and decapitated him. The exact reason for Bracken's murder would remain unknown for many years; Solem would claim that Bracken demanded to duel to defend his honor. Others theorized that Bracken and Solem were lovers and that Solem had grown tired of him; or that Solem killed Bracken to upset War, who had long spurned his advances; or that Solem had grown bored of Amenth and killed Bracken to antagonize War into starting a great conflict so he could escape Amenth in the chaos. Because of the murder of Bracken and his other crimes, Solem was sentenced to eternity in the pit beneath the Tower of Broken Will.
powers: Regenerative Healing Factor: Bracken was known as a self-regenerator, and considered unbeatable as long as his powers functioned.
weapons: Hellblade: Bracken wielded a Hellblade, an enchanted dagger that would damn anyone killed by it to Hell.

X-Statix fought with themselves over whether or not to save her and they eventually teleported inside the store and Mister Sensitive seemingly broke his neck. brad gutman.name: Brad Gutman
brad gutman.origin: Brad Gutman was a mortician for X-Statix and also a necrophiliac, abusing of the bodies left in the mortuary. Although disgusted by him, his wife Brenda still tried keeping him sexually satisfied by looking like Dead Girl, on whom Brad had a crush/obsession. His daughter Britney, realizing her father's pathology, wore makeup to look like Dead Girl and went to school with a gun. The real Dead Girl tried to talk her down but the police opened fire, killing Britney. Brad took his daughter's body to the mortuary. There, he was confronted and killed by Dead Girl, who then reanimated his body and summoned the ghosts of his victims to take their revenge.

brad wrangle.name: Brad Wrangle
brad wrangle.origin: Brad Wrangle was an actor for Mallett Studios who primarily acted in Western films. Unknown to anyone, save for other cult members at the stuido, Brad was also the leader of a cult which worshipped a dark god out in Serentity Springs, California. The dark being known only as the Father of All Worlds required a blood sacrifice each month at the time of the full moon from the cult's members. In exchange, the cult members all had their power increased by being molded more in the image of their deity, they were each given four prehensile tentacles on their chest which secreted a burning slime . Brad met Jack Russell at the Burbanks and Mallet movie studios when Jack saved an actress from a horse that had gone wild. He was impressed with Jack's handling of the situation and offered him a job as a stunt man . When Brad heard that Buck Cowan was trying to get someone at the studio to make an old script he had written into a movie, he told Buck that he would be willing to make it himself. Buck, Jack Russell and their friend Clary all went to Serenity Springs with the film crew. Upon reaching the small town, they noticed that there was something odd about it. There was no restaurants, no electricity and hardly any inhabitants. Regardless, they went on with the crew and continued setting up for filming. While Jack was filming a stunt for the film, there was an accident and he fell over the side of a gorge, only to be swept downstream in the river. That evening, Buck and Clary discovered one of the crew members dying and he tried to explain the horrible events which take place here. They were then knocked unconscious, however, and were to be used as sacrifices to the cultists dark god. The next evening Jack stumbled across where the cultits performed their rituals and saw Buck and Clary tied upside down over a pit. He too was then knocked unconscious and tied up with the others. As the moon rose, however, Jack transformed into the Werewolf and broke free, killing several of the cultists. As Brad tried to stop him, his dark god awakaned angrily which began a cave-in. The demon then ate Brad himself as Buck and Clary escaped. The entire cave collapsed mere moments later .
weapons: Wrangle sometimes used a knife in his sacrifices to his god.
weaknesses: The members of the Cult were required to give their god a monthy sacrifice for fear of his reprisal.

fields.unusual_features: Brad Wrangle had four prehensile tentacles which protruded from his chest

bradley hunter.name: Bradley (Hunter)
bradley hunter.origin: Bradley was a game hunter who traveled into the wilds of Africa to finds animals to sell to zoos and circuses back in the United States. Coming across the hunting camp of Rajah Sarput, he became interested in purchasing Sarput's latest capture, the lion known as Zar. Sarput refused to sell the animal, prompting Bradley to hire natives to help him steal the lion instead. Bradley loaded Zar aboard a ship bound for a zoo in America unaware that Zar's "brother Ka-Zar had come aboard to recover his "sibling". However, Ka-Zar made his presence known in attempting to free Zar, and Bradley stopped the jungle man's attempt by threatening to shoot him with a gun. Bradley attempted to capitalize on the capture of Ka-Zar as well. However, the jungle man broke himself and Zar free, and they jumped overboard as the ship neared New York. Bradley's subsequent activities remain unrevealed.

bradley costello.name: Bradley Costello
bradley costello.origin: Brad Costello is a homicide detective working for the JCPD. He was assigned the case of Sophie Brownlee's murder. He called P.I. Jessica Jones after finding out Mrs. Brownlee had contacted her prior to her death. After hearing Jessica being kidnapped by Spot on the other line, Costello went to Jones' office in Manhattan, where he encountered her husband Luke Cage. They continued talking about Jessica as they stepped out of the building and found her on the street returning to her office, but she flew away immediately. Costello was later visited by Jessica Jones at his Jersey City precinct in order to offer her help with the Brownlee murder investigation. Brad directed her to the interrogation room, where they had Mr. Brownlee detained, who had been asking to talk to Jessica.

bradley kroon.name: Bradley Kroon
bradley kroon.origin: ===Origin=== Icemaster's origins are a mystery and the source of his powers remains unrevealed. ===First Exploit=== Seeking to create another ice age, the Icemaster had frozen much of New York City, only to face the Human Torch and was defeated. ===Masters of Evil=== One of twenty-five villains who joined the second Crimson Cowl's Masters of Evil, Icemaster and the other Masters planned to extort billions from the world's governments through their weather-control technology, but their base was infiltrated by the Thunderbolts. The Icemaster, along with the Masters of Evil, was beaten by the Thunderbolts and jailed. ===Fear Itself=== left|thumb|100px|De-powered Eventually imprisoned in the Raft, he later escaped when Juggernaut became possessed by the Asgardian entity Kuurth and destroyed the prison. Escaping through a New England town alongside Aftershock, Ember, and Whirlwind, they were opposed by Speedball. When angry townsfolk attacked Speedball, thinking his departure would cause the villains to leave more quickly, the villains made their escape. Following the conclusion of the Serpent's attack on Earth, Speedball gathered his fellow Avengers Academy staff members, along with the students, and confronted Icemaster, Aftershock, and Ember. While the group had the villains on the ropes, it was ultimately the arrival of industrialist Jeremy Briggs that led to the defeat of the villains. Later incarcerated in an up state New York prison not designed to handle superpowered individuals, Icemaster was part of a large riot amongst the powered prisoners, including Griffin, Schizoid Man, and Lightmaster. Initially opposed by a contingent of Guardsmen, the villains were ultimately stopped by the only heroes able to respond to the incident: the X-Men Rogue and Mimic.
powers: The Icemaster can create blasts of cold, ice missiles and walls of ice from ambient moisture, as well as forming sleet, snow, and freezing rain.

fields.history: ===Origin=== Icemaster's origins are a mystery and the source of his powers remains unrevealed. ===First Exploit=== Seeking to create another ice age, the Icemaster had frozen much of New York City, only to face the Human Torch and was defeated. ===Masters of Evil=== One of twenty-five villains who joined the second Crimson Cowl's Masters of Evil, Icemaster and the other Masters planned to extort billions from the world's governments through their weather-control technology, but their base was infiltrated by the Thunderbolts. The Icemaster, along with the Masters of Evil, was beaten by the Thunderbolts and jailed. ===Fear Itself=== left|thumb|100px|De-powered Eventually imprisoned in the Raft, he later escaped when Juggernaut became possessed by the Asgardian entity Kuurth and destroyed the prison. Escaping through a New England town alongside Aftershock, Ember, and Whirlwind, they were opposed by Speedball. When angry townsfolk attacked Speedball, thinking his departure would cause the villains to leave more quickly, the villains made their escape. Following the conclusion of the Serpent's attack on Earth, Speedball gathered his fellow Avengers Academy staff members, along with the students, and confronted Icemaster, Aftershock, and Ember. While the group had the villains on the ropes, it was ultimately the arrival of industrialist Jeremy Briggs that led to the defeat of the villains. Later incarcerated in an up state New York prison not designed to handle superpowered individuals, Icemaster was part of a large riot amongst the powered prisoners, including Griffin, Schizoid Man, and Lightmaster. Initially opposed by a contingent of Guardsmen, the villains were ultimately stopped by the only heroes able to respond to the incident: the X-Men Rogue and Mimic.
powers: The Icemaster can create blasts of cold, ice missiles and walls of ice from ambient moisture, as well as forming sleet, snow, and freezing rain.
fields.trivia: Initially, the ad company wanted the villain of the ad to be named "Iceman," unaware that Iceman was already the name of a superhero. Frank Miller, the ads artist, created Icemaster as a replacement.

bradley landers.name: Bradley Landers
bradley landers.origin: Bradley Landers was one of the U.S. Generals who sent a highly trained team after the Punisher. They managed to eventually capture him as Frank would not use lethal force against U.S. soldiers. The man the Generals used to run this operation had, unbeknownst to them, been saved by Castle in the early days of his military career and felt that he owed Castle, leading him to let Castle go and walk away just as the Generals were coming to kill him personally. As none of the Generals had any combat experience Castle killed them all with ease.

bradley manning.name: Bradley Manning
bradley manning.origin: thumb|left|95px|Bradley Manning Bradley Manning was the cousin of Joel Manning who was independently wealthy. Seeking to obtain his cousin's fortune he developed the identity of the Cadaver and kidnapped Joel's wife Joan in the fall of 1944 and demanded a ransom. Joel then contacted the Human Torch and Toro asking for their assistance in rescuing Joan. Unaware that Bradley was really the Cadaver, he went to the Tunnel of Horror at the nearby amusement park to meet with the Cadaver with the Torch and Toro following not far behind. In a darkened part of the tunnel Bradley changed into the Cadaver and captured Joel and took him to his secret hideout reuniting him with his wife. Having been forewarned about the Torch's involvement, the Cadaver then led the hero and his sidekick into an air tight asbestos lined room that he then began pumping gas into and left them to die. He then took Joel and Joan to the top of the roller coaster. There he welded a piece of metal to the track that would cause the roller coaster to derail, killing both Joel and Joan. By this time the Torch and Toro had escaped from their death trap and quickly defused the situation. After melting the metal on the track, the Torch and Toro then rounded up the Cadaver's men. When attempting to capture the Cadaver, the villain lost his footing and fell to his death. Recovering the body, the Torch unmasked the Cadaver as Bradley Manning and they all realized his motivation for the kidnapping.

family: Joel Manning (cousin) Joan Manning (relative by marriage)

bradley martin.name: Bradley Martin
bradley martin.origin: The sheriff of Jude, New Mexico. Martin knew that criminal physician Dr. W. Lee Benway was hiding a local villa, 10 miles north of Jude; and he knew that Benway had captured fugitive Johnny Yen; Martin was Benway's accomplice. When the Hulk reached his town looking for food, Martin tried to stop him with his deputies even shooting at him, but the Hulk escaped by smashing the street and having all the agents fall on their backs. The sheriff ordered cars to follow him, but the car drivers decided to keep their distance. Soon afterward, bounty hunter Spider-Woman visited Sheriff Martin, on LAPD's Captain Alexander Walsh's recommendation. Spider-Woman had tracked Yen to Jude; and Martin told her that Yen had been in the city and eventually went to a clinic a doctor had in his villa; but Martin then called the doctor to warn him of the incoming heroine. Thou Martin tried to stop Spider-Woman, she escaped and contacted her allies Captain Walsh and Scott McDowell to ask for the Arizona State Patrol, having understood that the local sheriff was an enemy. Benway summoned the Sheriff to help him escape; and when Spider-Woman stopped Benway with a venom blast, the Sheriff shot Spider-Woman, injuring her. The Sheriff intended to kill her by a point-blank shot, but the Hulk caused an explosion in the villa, and a piece of debris knocked hit the Sheriff. Spider-Woman then knocked him down with a venom blast, and apparently delivered him to the State Patrol.
weapons: A normal gun and one of Benway's stun-guns set to kill.

bradley miles.name: Bradley Miles
bradley miles.origin: Congressman Bradely Miles lost his right hand in a shark attack. One month later, he gave a speech at a science and technology convention about his cybernetic prosthetic provided by Biotechnix. Spider-Man later found out that Miles may have abused his status to receive priority care and decided to investigate further, only to find that Biotechnix was employing Doctor Octopus under the control of Fusion. Upon further investigation, Spider-Man found out that the prosthetics made by Biotechnix could be used to mind-control their users. Fusion then gathered Doctor Octopus and Miles to discuss their plans following a fight with Spider-Man. After clarifying that Miles was the only other witness to their scheme, Doctor Octopus killed him as part of his own plan to betray Fusion.

bradley shaw.name: Bradley Shaw
bradley shaw.origin: Bradley Shaw was a chemical scientist who created a Spider-Serum that would give him spider powers. He impersonated Spider-Man when committing crimes until he mutates into Nephilia: a mutant with the torso of a man and a spider's body from the waist down. Bradley Shaw went on a crime spree with Spider-Man’s powers and his costume, blaming Spider-Man for his crimes. The serum later began having a strange effect on both him and Spider-Man as their spider-senses started jamming one another, and Bradley Shaw later turned into a giant spider. After battling, Spider-Man managed to give Shaw the antidote to his original formula, turning him into a human once again.
abilities: Brilliant scientist who was able to create a serum that gave him powers similar to Spider-Man's

fields.unusual_features: As Nephilia, his lower body was spider-like including six legs. Later, he became a giant spider.

brady briedel.name: Brady Briedel
brady briedel.species: Transformed into a demonic entity by the fear gasses he developed for Mr. Fear.
brady briedel.origin: A small-time drug dealer turned chemist tasked with fear gasses for Mr. Fear (along with various designer drugs and special chemical compounds for other villains). When the Hammer of Angrir landed in Yancy Street and was picked up by Ben Grimm (the Thing), the explosive energies that were released by the transformation caused Briedel's lab to cave in on him, crushing him, slicing him with shrapnel and bathing him in the chemicals and compounds he worked with. No longer afraid of death, he prepared to succumb, only to suddenly find the strength to rise, emerging from the rubble as a blackened, demonic creature emanating green flames. left|150px Following the departure of Angrir, Paladin and Gargoyle began searching the rubble for survivors. Finding several scared of something in the rubble, the duo investigated, where Christians was met with a shining vision. His screams for forgiveness for choosing to "embrace darkness" allowed Paladin to find him, turned to stone, amidst the smoke and settling dust. Paladin then found himself confronted by a "better" version of himself, who swiftly beat him unconscious. Briedel then revealed himself, standing over the defeated pair. Attacking rescuers and those they sought to rescue, Briedel took pride in his new abilities, dubbing himself "Monster." When Misty Knight arrived, seeking Paladin and Gargoyle, he confronted her, only to find that her greatest fear was the child she'd lost. Becoming a frightened child, Briedel fled. Hired by Purple Man, Briedel joined his Villains for Hire team. Deployed against Misty Knight's rival team, he faced Crossfire, transforming into Crossfire's greatest fear: Hawkeye. Monster was later part of the Villains for Hire assault on Misty Knight's headquarters, though he was quickly taken out by one of the many traps Knight employed.
